about_the_game:
Hello, I’m Fatih.

With zero game development experience, I completed every stage of my own game in just one month, entirely with the help of AI. From coding to design, from an idea to a playable reality, this journey has been one of the most challenging yet most rewarding experiences of my life.

This game is the result of determination combined with the possibilities of modern technology. Your support will be my greatest motivation to take this journey even further.

Escape the Maze 

Escape the Maze combines horror and puzzle elements to deliver a tense co-op escape experience. As you explore dark labyrinths, your intelligence, courage, and teamwork will constantly be tested. Each map is designed to create a unique atmosphere, introduce new challenges, and offer distinctive puzzles.

The mazes are not only complex in structure but also filled with puzzles that require logic, memory, and attention. Some situations demand quick individual decisions, while others encourage cooperation with friends to find the right solution. Wrong choices can lead you into dead ends—or into deadly traps you might not notice until it’s too late.

Your goal is to find hidden exits, progress to the next stage, and survive through all the labyrinths. But escape won’t be easy: limited visibility, an unsettling atmosphere, and unexpected surprises will keep you on edge at all times.

Key Features

  • Horror Meets Puzzles – Test both your wit and bravery in a dark and suspenseful atmosphere.

  • Co-op Multiplayer – Play together with friends or take on the challenge solo.

  • Progressive Levels – 7 unique maps with distinctive layouts and increasing difficulty.

  • Escape Experience – Complex labyrinths filled with hidden paths, deadly traps, and challenging puzzles.

  • Evolving Content – During Early Access, we plan to add new maps, puzzles, and features based on player feedback.

Zombie

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains horror themes, including tension, dark environments, and encounters with a zombie enemy. It also includes suggestive content with two female characters in bikinis dancing. There is no nudity, sexual acts, or non-consensual content. The game does not contain drug/alcohol use or self-harm themes.

short_description: Escape the Maze is an action, adventure, and horror game that you can play with up to 3 friends. While searching for escape routes together and trying to reach the final level, you will experience a truly immersive gameplay thanks to in-game voice chat.
